While any four $\pm 1$ will have an even sum, the parity constraint in a broader lattice context (like $D_n$) ensures that the difference between any two points has an even sum of coordinates, which is a necessary condition for the $D_n$ lattice and helps maintain the minimum distance of $\sqrt{2}$ (or 2 for norm-4).

This is computationally much cheaper.
